headline: Intense Battles Shake Weathered Expanse and Northern Frontiers
war_summary: Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm maintain their fierce tempo, with Weathered Expanse logging nine base transfers in the last two hours alone across Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, leaving two strategic positions desolate in no-man's-land. In Palantine Berm, Warden forces have consolidated total hex control following five recent base exchanges around The Droll and Pippeli Stones. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage continues to endure massive casualty tolls, registering over twelve hundred fallen across both lines in two hours while Crumbling Post remains heavily contested and one strongpoint sits abandoned. Action has also expanded into Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, where Colonial forces now hold eight bases apiece following recurrent clashes at Breaker Town, Port of Rime, and The Reach. In contrast, earlier flashpoints in Dead Lands and Viper Pit have subsided into lull, and sectors like Kuura Strand and Callum's Cape have quieted following previous assaults.
